question: In the double helix structure of Watson and Crick for DNA:

options.opa: Two polynucleotide chains are associated forming a double helix to the left.
options.opb: The nitrogenous bases of the two chains are joined through 2 or 3 disulfide bridges.
options.opc: The pairs of formed bases are located in planes parallel to the axis of the double helix.
options.opd: The phosphate groups are exposed to the outside of the double helix.
